name: guarddog-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is GuardDog, a Python command-line tool and library that identifies malicious PyPI and npm
packages and other open-source artifacts. This task covers its scanning core: YARA source-code analysis, the risk
engine that correlates capabilities and threats and scores packages, the PyPI and npm metadata detectors, the
reporters, the package and project scanners for PyPI, npm, VSCode extensions and Rust crates, archive extraction,
configuration and the command line.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code in scope is these Python modules of the guarddog package: guarddog/__init__.py, guarddog/__main__.py, guarddog/cli.py, guarddog/ecosystems.py and guarddog/sandbox.py; guarddog/analyzer/analyzer.py, guarddog/analyzer/risk_engine.py and guarddog/analyzer/sourcecode/__init__.py; every module directly in guarddog/analyzer/metadata/, guarddog/analyzer/metadata/pypi/, guarddog/analyzer/metadata/npm/ and guarddog/reporters/; guarddog/scanners/__init__.py, guarddog/scanners/scanner.py and the PyPI, npm, VSCode extension and Rust crate scanners in guarddog/scanners/ (pypi_package_scanner.py, pypi_project_scanner.py, npm_package_scanner.py, npm_project_scanner.py, extension_scanner.py, crates_package_scanner.py and cargo_project_scanner.py); and guarddog/utils/archives.py, guarddog/utils/config.py, guarddog/utils/exceptions.py, guarddog/utils/npm.py and guarddog/utils/package_info.py. The documentation in scope is README
